svg.title: Where the pixels live in memory
svg.desc: An eight by six band with letters. Column 2 holds c, k, s, A, I, Q, which are eight boxes apart when the rows are laid end to end in memory.
svg.text: Where the pixels live in memory
Memory is one long street of numbered boxes.
c k s A I Q
They are 8 boxes apart in memory.
the same band in memory, row after row:
In a real image the gap is the image width: 2400 boxes. The six
pixels of one column land in six different parts of memory.
